- consequence: Algorithm: opaque origin -> Not Trustworthy; scheme https or wss -> Potentially Trustworthy; host matching 127.0.0.0/8 or ::1/128 -> Potentially Trustworthy; host localhost/ .localhost (when the UA conforms to let-localhost-be-localhost) -> Potentially Trustworthy; scheme file -> Potentially Trustworthy.
